findings.title: Artifact lacks an integrity digest
findings.action: Generate an integrity digest before storing, diffing, or executing the artifact.

findings.title: Artifact exceeds configured storage limits
findings.action: Route the artifact through large-object storage with resumable upload and quota approval.

findings.title: Dataset lacks a metadata-aware schema preview
findings.evidence: data/raw-assay.csv has no inferred schema preview.
findings.action: Infer columns, types, and row counts before showing the dataset as reusable.

findings.title: Code artifact lacks diff support
findings.evidence: code/train_model.py cannot be diffed across upload versions.
findings.action: Enable code-aware diffs for scripts, notebooks, and environment files.

findings.title: Artifact file type is not supported by the hosting preview layer
findings.action: Add a supported preview/execution handler or reject the upload before publication.

findings.title: Hosted artifact bundle lacks a persistent identifier
findings.action: Attach a DOI or UUID before indexing the bundle as findable.

findings.title: Reusable artifact bundle lacks a license
findings.action: Set a data/code license before public sharing or API export.

findings.title: Structured metadata is incomplete
findings.action: Generate DataCite, JSON-LD, and schema.org metadata before DOI registration or discovery indexing.

findings.title: FAIR discovery metadata is thin
findings.action: Add scientific keywords, variables, instruments, organisms, or method tags.

findings.title: Public bundle contains restricted data
findings.evidence: bundle-multimodal-assay-001 is public while at least one artifact is restricted.
findings.action: Keep restricted artifacts private or remove them from the public bundle.

findings.title: Artifact access audit logging is disabled
findings.evidence: bundle-multimodal-assay-001 has no access audit log.
findings.action: Enable audit logs for downloads, previews, and execution events.

findings.title: Executable artifacts lack a runtime environment
findings.evidence: bundle-multimodal-assay-001 has no container image or environment file.
findings.action: Attach a Docker image, Dockerfile, or environment.yml before enabling execution.

findings.title: Execution sandbox is disabled
findings.evidence: bundle-multimodal-assay-001 would run code without sandbox enforcement.
findings.action: Enable sandbox isolation before notebooks, scripts, or model workflows can execute.

findings.title: Sandbox limits exceed policy
findings.action: Require compute approval or reduce resource limits before scheduled runs.

findings.title: No reproducibility trigger is configured
findings.evidence: bundle-multimodal-assay-001 has no run-analysis or reproduce-results trigger path.
findings.action: Add a notebook, script, or workflow trigger that rebuilds results from hosted artifacts.

findings.title: Artifact bundle version is invalid
findings.action: Use a semantic version tag for data/code bundle publication.

findings.title: Upload diff manifest is missing
findings.evidence: bundle-multimodal-assay-001 has no diff manifest for the current upload.
findings.action: Generate a file-level diff manifest so reviewers can inspect changes across versions.

findings.title: Rollback checkpoint is missing
findings.evidence: bundle-multimodal-assay-001 cannot roll back to a known-good artifact state.
findings.action: Create a rollback checkpoint before accepting large artifact changes.
